description: F3 long: Pell buys a map Hask forged at 13; the break is at 25.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Behind his stall, the peddler Hask inks a fake vault map, copying the coastline wrong on purpose.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: Pell pays Hask ten silver for the map and thanks him warmly, sure it leads to the drowned vault.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Gulls fight over fish heads on the quay.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: Pell asks about boats for hire.

transcript.speaker: Hask
transcript.text: "Try the widow Orla, two piers down," Hask says.

transcript.speaker: Pell
transcript.text: Pell buys a salted herring for the road.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: A bell rings the change of watch.

transcript.speaker: Hask
transcript.text: Hask starts packing up his stall.

transcript.speaker: Narrator
transcript.text: Clouds roll in from the sea.

transcript.speaker: Hask
transcript.text: Hask pulls the canvas over his wares.
